How joining will work

  1. Find and review your public profile.
  2. Claim the profile and verify appropriate authority through the secure member system when it opens.
  3. Choose the membership that fits your organization.
  4. Complete your richer profile first: logo, website/contact, description, services and photos.
  5. Preview and publish through authenticated profile management.

Important boundaries

  • Membership does not buy factual accuracy or ordinary directory rank.
  • A member mark indicates community participation, not certification or endorsement.
  • Checkout remains closed until account, billing, cancellation, support and member access work together.

Enrollment is opening later.

No payment can be made on Franklin Navigator today. When enrollment opens, authorized pricing, renewal and cancellation terms will be shown together.
